scroll.title: Scrolling
scroll.description: pinned keeps the layers that fit in view while longer ones slide; sheet moves the whole graph.

labels.title: Long labels
labels.description: wrap breaks a long label onto more lines; clip cuts it to one.

links.title: Links
links.description: separate gives each node's links lines of their own; merged lets them share, which is shorter.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: still lights the selected node's links; flowing also sets them moving.

replies.title: Graphs in replies
replies.description: on lets Claude draw graphs in its normal replies; off keeps graphlet out of Claude's replies and the system prompt, leaving it only for mods that use it.

pictures.title: Pictures in apps (experimental)
pictures.description: off draws a graph on the desktop app, VS Code extension, and the mobile app as text in a code block; on draws it as a picture, with controls under a mod's graph.
